_comment: NOT-298: one Grok/xAI remote-MCP agent connector. Duplicate the entry per agent with a different x-agent-deck-deck-id for that agent's durable default. Map server_url / authorization / headers to the xAI remote-MCP tool fields. server_url must be a reachable Streamable HTTP MCP URL (hosting is ops, not an Agent Deck product concept). authorization is the grant secret xAI places in the Authorization header — use the bare secret unless the host UI already expects a full 'Bearer …' value (confirm on the connector form; do not double-prefix). Wire form Agent Deck accepts: Authorization: Bearer <grant-secret>.
